about: ElevenLabs clips for the promo (tools/promo/audio.mjs). Music is composed to the cut in tools/promo/edit.mjs: it enters at 7.5 s when the terminal gives way to the temple, so the plan's sections are the reveal, the wander, the company and the way home. Everything diegetic (fights, spells, guards, the mayor, ambience) is the game's own committed clips in assets/audio.

clips.prompt: 1990s dial-up modem connecting: a dial tone, touch-tone dialling, then the screeching handshake, hiss and warble, ending abruptly in silence. Heard from a small computer speaker in a quiet room.
Classic 56k dial-up modem handshake sound, beeps then the famous screech and static, cut off sharply at the end, small tinny speaker

Someone typing a few short words on an old clicky mechanical keyboard from the early 1990s, buckling-spring keys, small pauses between words, ending with a firm press of the enter key. Close, dry, quiet room.
A heavy old wooden town gate slowly swinging open, deep creak of iron hinges, a chain rattling, then wind and birds outside. Medieval, outdoors.

positive_global_styles: small early-music ensemble of three players
recorded live in a small wooden room, dry and intimate, historically informed, instrumental only

positive_local_styles: solo lute arpeggio, slow, tender, as if opening a door
alto recorder enters softly on a long note at the end
the three play together, walking pace around 92 bpm
lute plucks a steady dance pulse, recorder carries a simple singable tune, vielle drones underneath
same tune passed to the vielle, a little livelier, estampie-like dance rhythm in the lute
playful, a wink, companions on the road
slowing down, the recorder plays the tune once more quietly over a held vielle drone
ends on a clear final cadence and one soft lute chord left ringing
